scientific_integrity: Self-contained mathematical proof with independent finite graph-based checks over nineteen parameter profiles; finite enumeration does not establish the infinite-family claim. No independent scientific audit or validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Counts precisely minimum-weight Italian dominating functions on labeled two-factor rook graphs; it does not give the full weight polynomial. The numerical square-graph domination value is previously published. The complete 2019 Klostermeyer–MacGillivray publisher PDF was not accessible for thorough inspection; bibliographic overlap remains a risk.
title: A surjection-to-row-weight transition for minimum Italian domination on \(K_m\square K_n\)
